title: Save safety workflow
summary: Inspect and protect saves before experiments.
content: Save Manager is inspection, backup, verification, restore preview, and safe restore only. It does not directly edit save contents.

title: Profiles and isolation
summary: Use separate profiles for stable play and research.
content: The Default profile is intended for stable play. The Research profile is an isolated surface for experimental settings and evidence.

title: Module boundaries
summary: Modules use contracts and explicit capability boundaries.
content: Normal workflows can be embedded in Control Center. Trainer, Research, and other higher-risk tools may run as separate processes with an explicit launch context.

title: Evidence before in-game claims
summary: An offline build or registration result does not prove visible in-game behavior.
content: Treat successful validation, packaging, or runtime registration as an intermediate result only. A feature should remain experimental or research-only until the target Enshrouded build has fresh runtime evidence and, where relevant, in-game visual confirmation. Record the build context and limitations before promoting the result.
